items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Rolando Alfonso, Jesus and me. We were the . . . the rhthym section of Bebo Valdés’ Orquesta Ritmo de Batanga.

ctx.x: From there I came to the United States in 1946 with a pair of dancers, Carmen and Rolando. They were the ones that brought me.
But I understand that before you traveled to the United States with them, you were traveling throughout Cuba with them, right?
